rows.TEXT: In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Known in his times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended his reign of terror. He is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to his will.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Master Occultist 
"Your Uther has helped us much... We have accepted his mission to destroy you in his name, demons!"

Demonologist 
"Master, Uther has given the Undead what they wanted! They band together against us!"

Master Occultist 
"We have seen enough of you... Mortis will be pleased with your demise! Servants! attack!!!"

Templar 
"Uther will soon replace Bethrezen as lord of hell... Why try to fight what is inevitable?"

Duke 
"It seems that the Undead have allied with Uther. We must destroy them as well to vanquish our foe..."

Duke 
"There is evidence that the Undead Hordes and the Empire were present here! This is unusual..."

Demon Uther 
"Be warned... You have challenged me for the last time! Your presence here is a insult to me and to Hell itself!"

Demonologist 
"You are not our master! Bethrezen will come to our aid..."

Demon Uther 
"Fools! You have been blinded! Bethrezen's powers will soon be mine..."

Demonologist 
"Master, an Infernal Rift opens before us..."

Demonologist 
"We must protect it from Demon Uther's  claws. Bethrezen will send us aid through the Rift, he has revealed it to me in a dream..."

Orc Champion 
"We fight same... We need fight ally..."

King's Guard 
"You are lucky that Morok is no more... Fear not, his daughter Yataa will take care of you!"

Counselor 
"It seems the Mountain Clans are weakened, Master! Something happened to their High King Morok!"

Elder Vampire 
"When Mortisss' conssssort issss reborn, even Uther will be no match for them..."

Archmage 
"Uther is back, Demons! The Empire will prosper once more! He is a saint, I have witnessed his miracles!"

Demonologist 
"It seems that the Empire has fallen under the charms of Uther... They do not see him as he really is."

Knight Droggon 
"Our Emperor Uther will destroy you... He has returned to save the Empire."

Sorcerer 
"The new Emperor!?! What is this, a rumor or the truth?"

Pegasus Knight 
"Leave at once! Uther's Angels shall defend us!!"

Sorcerer 
"Uther's Angels!?! Ha ha ha! You put your trust in mere Illusions! Such is Uther's trickery..."

Elder Vampire 
"We will take what'sss left of your flesssh when Mortisss intervenesss... Gallean will return to avenge usss all!"

Cultist 
"Gallean? Is he not an Elven god?"

Orc 
"Good you come. King Gurkenash wait for ghou, he talk."

Grumsh 
"King Gurkenash ask talk to you. Come with us!"

Counselor 
"DRAGON! Beware, Master! The beast is headed this way... Prepare yourselves for battle!"

Gurkemesh 
"I grow tired of this Uther... I will help you vanquish him. In the name of my tribe the Greenskins, we will destroy this accursed infant..."

Demonologist 
"Demon Uther is vanquished! Bethrezen is saved! Our battle was not in vain!"

Demon Uther 
"A fatal mistake... Your arrogance will destroy you! Asteroth - kill them!"

Orc 
"Good you come. King Gurkenash wait for ghou, he talk."

Gurkenash 
"How dare you attack my people? I will not tolerate these actions..."

Gurkenash 
"This time you have went too far, Demons! I will destroy you all!!!"

Demon 
"Treacherous demons! You will regret your blasphemous actions..."

Demon Uther 
"Bethrezen is dying. Ha ha ha ha! Pathetic beings, praying an extinct god..."

Modeus 
"We must hurry, Master. Our demonologists have warned us about Bethrezen's weakened state..."
Demonologist"Bethrezen has answered our prayers! He has summoned demons to aid us..."

Demonologist 
"Bethrezen is with us! He spent his last efforts to aid us... Now, we must defeat Demon Uther ourselves!"

Demonologist 
"We have traveled far... and now, finally we find the Rift! None should approach this gate, for they would surely destroy it... We must protect it at all costs!"

Demonologist 
"Yes, If any enemy unit enters the Rift, all will be lost for the Legions! We must also guard against enemy sorcery..."

Duke 
"The Infernal Rift has been destroyed - and with it, all contact with Bethrezen is lost! Uther now rules Hell... And we are outcasts! What place have we in this world?"

Demon Uther 
"I tire of your puny attempts to stop me. Flee now and I will be generous with you..."

Modeus 
"We must resist, Master! Bethrezen can be saved..."

Demon Uther 
"I have had enough of you... Prepare yourself to meet your Master! Now you die..."

Counselor 
"Master, Uther is headed toward the Infernal Rift! If he reaches it all is lost. You must stop him!"

Demonologist 
"The rift is destroyed... Uther has vanquished us! He is now the Master of Hell. What place have we in this world?"

Demonologist 
"Master, if I myself enter the Infernal Rift, Bethrezen will speak through me! I am sure of it, I feel him near us..."

King's Guard 
"Hail Demons! We fight the same enemies! If we unite we may together defeat them!"

Duke 
"Maybe it would be wise to use the clan armies against our enemies, Master..."

Counselor 
"Beware! The Mountains Clans are on the move... They have powerful armies!"

Duke 
"It seems the Mountain Clans have no allies on these lands... Maybe an alliance would be helpful against the forsaken child!"

Master Occultist 
"Mortis will be pleased! Prepare yourselves to meet the goddess of death!"

Duke 
"The Occultists are on the move... We must destroy them to protect the Infernal Rift!"

Demon Uther 
"We meet again! Watch me as I put Bethrezen out of his misery... Prepare to die, demons!"

Duke 
"Master, Demon Uther is on the move! We must stop him before he destroys the Infernal Rift! Bethrezen must not fall into oblivion..."
